dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Huh, little beetle, where do you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Little beetle...

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Yeah, a little beetle. Even smaller than the tiniest golden scarab.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Look at you, as thin as a stick. If you dare travel to the desert, you'll surely get crushed by the huge trunks and rocks left by King Deshret.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Take my advice, hire a capable bodyguard, or stay where people are, away from the desert!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rotten Ajilenakh Nuts...

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: You heard that? Don't worry about it. I wasn't talking about you.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: I was talking about the hateful smugglers and those rattling about "resurrecting King Deshret." Dimwits!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Like Ajilenakh Nuts rotting in the sand, they are sticky and annoying.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: It would be a relief to all of us if the stupid Akademiya were to take them down!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Bringing this up with the Navbed is no use, they just beat around the bush.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: It seems that wine is the only thing they wouldn't skirt around!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: I'm a mercenary from Aaru Village. If you're asking about the local nonsense, go annoy someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: It's a heck of a place, but at least life is better here than in Aaru Village.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Otherwise who would have come all the way here to work for the darn Akademiya? I'm not stupid!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Resurrecting King Deshret"?

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Foolish idea!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Toying with life and death is a futile endeavor!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: If King Deshret could rise from the sands, so could Greater Lord Rukkhadevata sprout from the soil!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: King Deshret is long gone. Those wannabes don't deserve the title of the Eremites if they can't even face it!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Death is the fairest thing in the world. A god high above or a bug deep in dirt, it comes for everyone all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Resurrecting King Deshret"?

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Pfft. A foolish notion!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Toying with life and death is a futile endeavor!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: If King Deshret would so easily rise up from a pile of sand and dust, could little sprouts that have just broken the soil not immediately grow into monumental trees?

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: King Deshret is long gone. Those wannabes claim the name of the Eremites in vain if they can't even face up to that fact!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Death is the fairest thing in the world. Whether a god high above or a bug down in the dirt, it comes for everyone all the same.
